resources.string: Shows a search button in every chat header. It opens the same search as chat details. Applies on this device only.
Shows a mute button in every chat header. Muting asks for how long; unmuting applies right away. Applies on this device only.
Shows a read-aloud button in every chat header. It turns reading new messages aloud on or off for that chat, the same as in chat details. Applies on this device only.
The header shows as many as fit beside the chat name, in the order you check them.
Shows a timer button in chats where you can change the disappearing messages timer. It opens the same picker as chat details. Applies on this device only.
Shows a members button in group chat headers. It opens the member list. Applies on this device only.
Shows an add-members button in group chats where you can add people. Applies on this device only.
